payload.core_composition_summary: Sort edges, keep K smallest, then repeatedly combine pairs of known paths to find and keep the K smallest shortest path distances.
payload.rationale: Sorting efficiently picks candidate edges. The while loop enumerates all pairs of current distances, updating when a shorter concatenated path is found, converging to exact shortest paths among selected edges.
